why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the node application page Use the Start a Node button on the Browser Cash homepage , which links to the node application page .
2 Step 2 : Install and activate the extension Install the Browser Cash extension and activate it. According to the homepage, this turns your browser into a node in the network.

3 Step 3 : Keep the node running Time online, finished tasks and the quality of your participation are what the homepage says points reflect. You can pause the node or turn it off from the extension or application whenever you choose.
4 Step 4 : Check your earnings Open the Browser Cash user dashboard , which the homepage banner says shows earnings across all your nodes.
